subject: Post-demo: Data controls playbook + MAP milestone (retention, logs, PHI/PII)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@luminahealth.com>; Lumina Health Security <security@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Data controls playbook + MAP milestone (retention, logs, PHI/PII)

Hi Ellen — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap + proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone focused on data handling/compliance so your security and legal teams have clarity. I attached a first-pass MAP page and our current SOC2 summary.

Key points from today’s call:
- Scope: production inference only (no model training or data retention for training).
- Data types: PHI will be redacted at ingestion for all PII/PHI fields we're aware of; Lumina will provide field-level schema.
- Retention: logs (request/response metadata, audit trail) retention target is 90 days by default; Lumina requested 365 days for audit purposes.
- Audit & logging: searchable, tamper-evident audit trail with export for auditors (CSV/JSON).
- KMS/HSM: keys customer-managed via AWS KMS or HSM is supported for Private deployments.

Proposed MAP milestone (Data Controls Playbook) — target close: 2026-06-30
1) Confirm authoritative data classification & required retention (owner: Lumina — Ellen) — due 2026-05-27
2) Redwood to provide retention-config options & cost delta (owner: Marcus Lin) — due 2026-05-29
3) Security questionnaire items & evidence bundle (SOC2 summary, encryption docs) (owner: Laura Bennett) — due 2026-06-04
4) Implementation plan for redaction/pseudonymization at ingestion or customer-side (owner: Lumina + Redwood ops) — dependency: schema from Lumina — due 2026-06-11
5) Sign-off on SLA and data handling Annex (owner: Legal on both sides) — target 2026-06-30

Next steps: Marcus will follow up with the retention cost estimate end of week; Laura will attach a short evidence bundle. Ellen — can you confirm who will own the data classification doc? Also please confirm whether Lumina needs full request/response retention or metadata-only (we heard \"audit-ready copies\" and want to be precise).

Attachments: RW-MAP-draft-data-controls-v1.pdf (MAP page), SOC2-summary-2025.pdf (summary)

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@luminahealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lumina Health Security <security@luminahealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Data controls playbook + MAP milestone (retention, logs, PHI/PII)

Thanks Jasmine — appreciated the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Lumina will own the data classification doc (I will share a first draft by 2026-05-26).
- For initial compliance we need 365 days of logs (including request metadata + anonymized response hashes) to satisfy our internal audit. Full response payload retention is not acceptable unless redacted.
- We prefer server-side redaction before storage where possible; if not, we will run a pseudonymization lambda in front of the API.

I'll loop in our Security lead (Ben Carter) in a separate note with any technical follow-ups. For now we agree to the milestone dates listed. Please add estimated cost for 365-day retention and the export SLA (bulk export cadence, format).

Cheers,
Ellen
Director, Digital Services — Lumina Health
ellen.park@luminahealth.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 14:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Data controls playbook + MAP milestone (retention, logs, PHI/PII)

Adding a few concrete items for the MAP milestone so we can hand this to pricing and SRE: 
- Retention options we can offer: 90d (base), 365d (audit), custom up to 3 years (enterprise). Cost impact: +18% monthly for 365d on the workloads discussed (ballpark; I will run model-level calc).
- Export SLA: generate ad-hoc exports within 24 hours; scheduled bulk exports (monthly) available as CSV/NDJSON. We can include checksum and signed manifest for tamper-evidence.
- For redaction: Redwood supports pre-ingest hooks (customer-side lambda) or hosted redaction before persistent storage on Private/Dedicated. Hosted (managed) redaction will require a SOC2 control review if we are processing PHI; it may push this to Private deployment for the first 90 days.

I'll produce a one-page cost delta and a short runbook for exports by 2026-05-29. Laura — will you confirm whether the SOC2 summary plus encryption docs suffice for Lumina's evidence checklist?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@luminahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Data controls playbook + MAP milestone (retention, logs, PHI/PII)

On Thu, May 20, 2026 at 2:55 PM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I'll produce a one-page cost delta and a short runbook for exports by 2026-05-29. Laura — will you confirm whether the SOC2 summary plus encryption docs suffice for Lumina's evidence checklist?

Ellen — quick note on evidence: SOC2 summary + our encryption-at-rest/in-transit brief and key management options should cover the initial evidence request. For any deep-dive requests (control narratives, pen-test reports, full SOC2 report) we'll need an NDA or controlled disclosure — we can coordinate that as a separate milestone.

Deliverables I'll provide by 2026-06-04:
- Evidence bundle: SOC2-summary-2025.pdf, encryption-kms-options.pdf, audit-log-format-spec.pdf
- Short note on what we can provide for PHI handling in Hosted vs Private (recommend Private for first 90 days of prod with customer-managed KMS)

Ellen — please confirm if Lumina expects the export manifest to contain anonymized response hashes or the full response (redacted). That will change the storage/processing notes.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Trust & Compliance, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
